note: The Migration Act 1958 extends to Christmas Island and deems it part of Australia, so a performer's permission to work there is Australia's (the au list); Australian citizens are home. Read again on 2026-11-03: legislation.gov.au said the same (the page's latest version is still the compilation of 8 October 2026 (C2026C00461); its text read from that compilation's PDF, volume 1).

sources.title: Migration Act 1958 (Cth), section 7, Act to extend to certain Territories (Federal Register of Legislation, compilation of 8 October 2026)
sources.said: (1) In this section, prescribed Territory means Norfolk Island, the Coral Sea Islands Territory, the Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands, the Territory of Christmas Island and the Territory of Ashmore and Cartier Islands. (2) This Act extends to a prescribed Territory. (3) Subject to this Act, a prescribed Territory: (a) shall be deemed to be part of Australia for the purposes of this Act;
